sources.snippet: To bridge this gap, we present JoVA, a unified framework capable of joint video-audio generation and editing within a single model (Fig. 1). To realize this architecture, we integrate pretrained video and audio models, streamlining the overall design by eliminating redundant multimodal fusion modules.
